messages:
emma: quick sync — i'm finishing the SOC2 audit-export page and i'd like a quick thumbs on the retention phrasing for embeddings. i updated the sample to show a 90-day TTL but worried language sounds like we 'store embeddings forever' in places. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428
liam: i skimmed — avoid 'we keep embeddings' phrasing. suggest: 'audit export may include derived artifact identifiers (e.g., embedding ids); customers can configure export retention via the export TTL.' keeps it factual and not prescriptive.
raju: +1. also added a tiny curl snippet to the PR that shows the export JSON shape for embedding rows. feel free to copy or shorten. snippet:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports 
  -d '{"type":"embeddings","range":{"from":"2025-01-01","to":"2025-03-01"},"ttl_days":90}'
```
marina: legal note: avoid 'we delete' vs 'we retain'. better: 'customers may request deletion or retention changes; export files are provided as-is and retention of exported artifacts is subject to the customer's storage policy.' also ask that we include a short line about pseudonymization as an example, not a guarantee.
emma: good call. i'll reword to: 'Exported files may contain pseudonymous identifiers derived from content. Customers should treat exported artifacts according to their data-handling policies.' does that sound ok?
liam: yeah that reads safer. one more nit: change 'TTL' to 'export_ttl_days' in the sample payload so SDKs map cleanly.
raju: updated snippet in the branch to use export_ttl_days and included a small example record schema with an "embedding_id" and "pseudonymization_method" fields.
jen: i can take the PR for a quick pass after emma updates the prose. also will run a link-checker job for the new example links.
docs-bot: link-checker started for PR #1428 — running 3 checks
emma: pushed edits per feedback (export_ttl_days + wording + pseudonymization note). left a comment for marina to confirm legal phrasing.
marina: wording LGTM with one micro tweak: change 'treat exported artifacts' -> 'treat exported artifacts in accordance with your internal retention and access policies.' i'm approving once that's in.
jen: i ran the link-checker locally — sample snippet and cross-references are valid. i'll merge after marina's final ok.
liam: thanks all. can we add a one-line migration note for SDKs: 'older clients used "ttl_days" in payloads; we accept both but prefer "export_ttl_days" going forward.' helps customers migrating.
emma: added migration note and a tiny example showing both fields accepted. ready for final merge when marina approves.
marina: approved.
docs-bot: PR #1428 merged by jen at 2025-06-12T16:52:25Z
